newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ayala Corp plans US$75 mln FRN - bankers.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Corp plans US$75 mln FRN - bankers.

text.p: Philippine conglomerate Ayala Corp plans to issue a US$75 million floating rate note issue through its special purpose vehicle AC International Finance Ltd, bankers said on Wednesday.
They said the issuer had awarded a mandate to Bankers Trust Asia to arrange the deal.
The paper was guaranteed by Ayala Corp.
They said the issue had a final maturity of five years with no put or call options.
It would pay a coupon of 90 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers will be over 100 basis points.
